description: This file defines the RouteCollector class in the Slim Framework, responsible for collecting routes, route groups, and generating paths/URLs. It manages route registration, caching, and route lookup functionalities.

classes.name: RouteCollector
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting and managing routes and route groups, generating URLs, and handling route caching within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: getRouteParser
methods.description: Returns the route parser instance used by the collector.

methods.name: getDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the default invocation strategy for routes.

methods.name: setDefaultInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the default invocation strategy for routes.

methods.name: getCacheFile
methods.description: Returns the path to the route cache file, if set.

methods.name: setCacheFile
methods.description: Sets the route cache file path, with validation for readability and writability.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path used in URL generation.

methods.name: setBasePath
methods.description: Sets the base path used in URL generation.

methods.name: removeNamedRoute
methods.description: Removes a route by its name.

methods.name: getNamedRoute
methods.description: Retrieves a route by its name.

methods.name: lookupRoute
methods.description: Finds a route by its identifier.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a route group with a pattern and callback.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a route group proxy.

methods.name: createProxy
methods.description: Creates a proxy for route grouping.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Adds a new route with specified methods, pattern, and handler.

methods.name: createRoute
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a new route.
